description: Run-directory naming contract: the readable stem is the run id reduced to [A-Za-z0-9._-] with a leading dot or dash replaced by an underscore, at most 48 characters, with the first character of a reserved device basename (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-COM9, LPT1-LPT9, in any case, alone or followed by an extension) replaced by an underscore, followed by '-' and the first 12 lowercase hex digits of the SHA-256 of the original id. The directory is a locator only; the runId inside the events stays authoritative.
